Glance at a one-factor CFA fit

Source: R/cfa_1.R
glance.dmar_cfa_1.Rd

Returns a one-row data.frame of model-level summaries in the column convention used by the broom ecosystem (cfi, tli, rmsea, rmsea_low, rmsea_high, AIC, BIC, logLik, comp_rel, npar).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'dmar_cfa_1'
glance(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A dmar_cfa_1 object returned by cfa_1.

...

Unused.

Value

A one-row data.frame.

Author

Ken Kelley kkelley@nd.edu
